description: Workload parameters of the testbed clients: device classes, request mix, arrival process and request content. The values are those of the default configuration file of the client emulator.
request_content: Each request draws one item of the test split of its family with replacement.

arrivals.process: 2-state Markov-modulated Poisson process, shared by the devices of one node and class; parameters in ../arrivals/mmpp_fit.json
arrivals.rate_in_state_i: base_rate * rel_rate[i] / sum_j pi_j rel_rate[j] (pi: stationary law of the modulating chain), so the long-run mean rate equals the base rate
arrivals.per_device_rate_heterogeneity: Gamma multiplier with mean 1 and coefficient of variation 0.5
arrivals.control: Poisson arrivals with the same long-run mean rate
